decisions.head: quantifiable
decisions.reason: The adjective's capability sense explicitly refers to quantification; WordNet explains numerical measurement. Suitable for quantitative study and business measures, without approving the old comparison.

explain.head: quantify
explain.reason: Explains quantified with the numerical measurement sense, not the logical-quantifier sense.

decisions.head: innovatively
decisions.reason: The manner adverb is grounded in the source's creation-of-new-ideas meaning of innovative. Appropriate general vocabulary; no claim of interchangeability with temporal originally.

explain.head: innovative
explain.reason: Select the creative new-ideas adjective explicitly referenced by the adverb, not the separate forward-looking sense.

decisions.head: explicitness
decisions.reason: The state noun is explained by the clear/specific adjective sense, appropriate for business communication. Excludes the distinct graphic/offensive-content sense.

explain.head: explicit
explain.reason: Clear/specific/detailed meaning resolves the clarity context; excludes offensive-content and textual-ending homonyms.

decisions.head: macroeconomist
decisions.reason: Reviewed hyphen-only spelling correction with unchanged letters and stable ID. Exact source defines an expert in large-scale economics, fitting the economist learning context.

decisions.head: housemade
decisions.reason: Reviewed hyphen-only correction to the exact source headword. Produced by the selling establishment fits hospitality vocabulary; not a claim that commercial housemade is identical to homemade.

decisions.head: press-up
decisions.reason: Reviewed hyphen insertion preserves every letter and stable ID. Source explicitly identifies the exercise synonym; regional UK/Ireland/Commonwealth labels are retained.

explain.head: push-up
explain.reason: Source press-up explicitly points to the exercise sense, not the bra or clothing adjective homonyms.
